text:
```yaml
name: PR Title Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - edited

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "18"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate PR title
        run: |
          npm exec commitlint -- --title "$(jq -r .pull_request.title github.event.json)" --config commitlint.config.js
```
